name: Both-Sides Dismantlable Classes Are Strictly Dismantlable Ample
scope: Finite binary classes under the minor-atlas displayed-coordinate conventions.
statement: Membership requires the original shore to be dismantlable, and examples with nondismantlable complements make the inclusion strict.
proof: Membership requires the original shore to be dismantlable, and examples with nondismantlable complements make the inclusion strict.
